# Round51 hafnon gap and elpidite curation

Recorded at 2026-10-12T08:34:17Z. Curator: codex (GPT-6; codex). Trusted base:466cb14cbc271ba73ba05e89ed188cfd113d06ea.

Admit [elpidite](../../../data/records/elpidite.yaml) as one mineral identity with qualified natural-specimen context. Hafnon remains deferred. No criticality or microbial mechanism is inherited from zirconium or hafnium.

## Evidence and scope

The September2026 IMA-CNMNC original was re-inspected at definitions page1 and Elpidite row page63. It lists Na2ZrSi6O15(H2O)3, grandfathered status,1894,Denmark(Greenland). The year is not a numbered accession. Original acquisition was round50 at07:32UTC on12October2026; this round reuses the same bytes, not a new live download.

[Cegiełka et al.2022](https://doi.org/10.24425/agp.2022.140427) is a complete11-page publisher original. All original pages,seven figures and six tables were inspected. A loose Dyrnaes River block was attributed to the Ilímaussaq Green Granite by its colour/mineralogy. Main Figures3B/6 and Table6 provide source-assigned elpidite context from microprobe chemistry and natural textures. They do not report sample-specific diffraction or a controlled transformation experiment. The primary sequence is a geological interpretation.

The analytical appendix and Supplementary Table1 were not acquired. Main representative analyses support a bounded occurrence statement; whole-dataset ranges,altered-sodium percentage and detailed missing instrument metadata are omitted. A local HTTP200 PGI landing response was a212-byte interstitial. The public web landing exposed only a main-PDF link,and PAS metadata returned a high-load verification page. No challenge was bypassed.

Table4 and Table6 both use analysis IL-356 under different material headings. Figure3C also labels SZR where its caption calls catapleiite. The record preserves IL-356 uncertainty and does not treat a map or chemistry alone as proof of a particular polymorph. Yusupovite has the same ideal composition; its discovered2015 author-hosted structural comparison remains a follow-up lead,not an inspected full source. No new yusupovite owner is created.

## Hafnon: changed routes and remaining gaps

The1974 Springer,2013 DeGruyter and prior unproductive RRUFF routes were not repeated unchanged. The previously acquired2016 synthetic-only paper remains insufficient for natural occurrence.

A new official Nanjing author profile was acquired but supplied only the2013 citation. New2024 DOI10.18654/1000-0569/2024.05.11 has indexed original text describing natural zirconian hafnon with Hf#0.67; ten figures and an appendix remain unacquired. Official HTTPS refused connection; HTTP403 and a prospective RHHZ mirror404 are preserved. The RHHZ URL was a tested candidate,not a verified existing mirror.

New2026 DOI10.3390/geosciences16020077 points back to natural Vasin-Mylk hafnon in2020 DOI10.1016/j.geoch.2018.12.001. The official2026 PDF/XML routes returned403; the2020 exact-title/DOI and institutional queries returned abstracts/citations only. Neither is accepted natural evidence here. The acquired21-page2025 Mineralogy original DOI10.35597/2313-545X-2025-11-1-4 instead describes zircon with Hf0.13–0.15apfu; screening it does not establish hafnon. Its full figures were not inspected or claimed.

The hafnon acceptance boundary remains complete natural-primary characterization,original phase/chemical evidence and relevant supplementary data,with historical compositional nomenclature resolved. No hafnon record or fabricated history is written.

## Search and access boundaries

Two cycle-safe searches included hidden/ignored files and followed symlinks in current and original checkout data,research,reviews,history plus cited raw roots. The follow-up covered3960 corpus text files and7325 total unique text files across170 existing referenced raw roots. Nine cited roots were missing and ten files exceeded16MB; unextracted binaries were not semantically searched. Receipts list exact paths and boundaries. No duplicate elpidite owner or this2022 study was found within those corpus directories; this is not a machine-wide absence claim.

Exact DOI/title notice queries and Crossref relation/update-to metadata identified no affecting notice in the returned bounded results. Dates disagree at day resolution (journalJune6 versus CrossrefJune8); only2022 is curated. Handbook text was readable through web but not acquired/visually inspected locally; Cannillo1973 MSA route403; Cametti2016 institutional URL returned200 with zero bytes. These are not full-source successes.

## Provenance, validation and handoff

Raw sources and originals remain outside Git at /private/tmp/cmm-round51-hf-zr-research. The paired JSON records acquisition URLs/UTC/statuses,exact artifact SHA-256 values,limits and source roles. Publisher redistribution rights were not established; only curator summaries are committed.

Useful next work: acquire natural hafnon originals and the2022 elpidite appendix before expanding quantitative or reaction claims. No source-access objective is declared complete by this narrower elpidite admission.
